initial_failures.detail: Complete builds passed; OpenGL four-phase scene passed; software scene stopped at phase 3 because the transparent window produced original RGB (48,96,48) rather than expected (47,95,47). BMP remained correct. Original-backend comparison reproduced the same color and identical central-half pixels.

right_edge_pure_color_expectation.detail: A one-pixel marker is linearly sampled and contains no exact full marker color. Inspected PNG has the expected bright edge; final check uses >80% contribution in the central right band and still checks BMP edge pixels exactly.
